**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear Miss Sewell,
Will not this do?

The M.S is come?

Hoping for you on the 25th

Yours affectionately

C M Yonge

[^1]: An envelope, which may go with this note, is postmarked Winchester 4 Ap 17 72, and addressed to “Miss E M Sewell/Bonchurch/I of Wight”.

Otherwise it seems more likely that the note dates from their collaboration in 1867-8.
